summary: LLM generation p95 latency exceeded its rolling anomaly band for over two minutes, delaying chat responses.
evidence_source: simulated Prometheus incident data; not live-cluster evidence

top_hypotheses.hypothesis: The configured generation provider experienced elevated response time while request volume remained near baseline.
A recent API deployment introduced slower prompt construction or retry behavior.

ruled_out.reason: LLM call volume was within 4.4% of its five-minute baseline.
The latency signal is from chat generation and did not coincide with a simulated queue-depth increase.

recommended_actions: Check generation-provider status, timeout telemetry, and provider-specific latency by model.
Compare prompt size, retry count, and deployment revision with the pre-incident baseline.
Temporarily route eligible traffic to an approved alternate provider only through the configured provider policy.
Keep LLMLatencySpikeAnomaly open until p95 remains below the anomaly upper bound for two evaluation intervals.
